# jsoncpp (vendored)

Amalgamated source of jsoncpp **1.9.6** (https://github.com/open-source-parsers/jsoncpp/releases/tag/1.9.6),
generated with `python amalgamate.py` from the release tarball. License: see `LICENSE` (MIT / public domain).

Compiled directly into the MATLAB MEX file so it does not depend on a jsoncpp shared library.
Do not add a file named `VERSION` here: on case-insensitive filesystems it shadows the C++ `<version>` header.
